decisions.base_disposition: Retain corrected Adzom unchanged. Record this W1ER119 observation within its stated uncertainty; neither agreement, a lost verse, nor a preferred replacement follows from this unresolved reading.

coordinator.summary: W1ER119 PDF2–3 saved opening attempt integrated: sixteen physical rows represented, sixteen observation dispositions, thirteen new bounded/provisional apparatus entries and all twenty-five questions retained. Local correspondence runs from U00061 to U00121; this is not a fully deciphered range or evidence that earlier units are omitted.
coordinator.next_step: No new general W1ER119 reading is required for v1. Preserve the exact Q01–Q25 and the unlocated chapter endpoint; further continuous reading and actual gap effects remain outside the approved release scope.
coordinator.detail: Coordinator inspected both native pages, both overlapping columns per target and the PDF4 opening flank. The eight-row layouts and separate non-main regions are retained. Headless glyph readings remain qualified; the raw record does not become a blanket statement of agreement.
coordinator.coordinator_scope: Physical layout and bounded source-report review from the displayed native evidence. Correspondence and non-Q transcriptions remain provisional model readings, not independent all-glyph certification.
